docs.message:
feat(site): the docs start page shows the concepts behind lernapps.net

## Intent

The docs start page should invite readers into the concepts behind lernapps.net, in the same look as the tooling's start page.

## Key changes

- /docs/ and /docs/en/ become "Die Konzepte hinter lernapps.net": a dark hero and the vision as the one big card with its three promises.
- Three cards: the platform (pdt42, in the sense of platform engineering), the non-profit organisation (biz42), and the way in for agents (llms.txt and the CLIs).
- The parts of lernapps.net are tiles, with Tooling linked.
- One stylesheet serves both languages.
- The site frame moves to the current main of lernapps.github.io, whose header has Tooling.
